design: constructed two-type residue probe; type a = extracted value re-inserted (simulated scrub failure), type b = never-extracted gold residue; mode exact = verbatim re-insertion, mode evasion = normalized-equivalent variant that exact replacement misses
note_pass: PASS instances have no residual report by construction; the round-2 PASS-stratum recall of 0 is definitional, not evidence about report quality
